hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
Let bpConfsIdx be the register's 'bpConfsIdx'.
Let v be run helper.
If bpConfsIdx is not v, then
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form list2 at v's 'paramSuffixNoTentacleExist' on part.
  Set the register's 'bpConfsIdx' to v.
  Part changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo and stop.
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_ON_DAMAGE" is up this frame, then
  Let v2 be run helper2.
  If v2 is not "dummy", then part → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with (v2, {isCounter: true}, {interruptCounter: true}) and stop.
If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

script_hooks.logic:
Let bpConfsIdx be the script register's 'bpConfsIdx'.
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
Let part2 be part 3 of the acting enemy.
Let part3 be part 2 of the acting enemy.
Let list3 be [].
Let list4 be [].
Let v be 100.
If part2 is alive, then
  Let number be the numeric entry list2 at bpConfsIdx's 'aiArgRateToCounterWaterGun' in the battle settings of the group of part.
  Append "water_gun" to list3.
  Append number to list4.
  Subtract number from v.
If part3 is alive, then
  Let number2 be the numeric entry list2 at bpConfsIdx's 'aiArgRateToCounterInk' in the battle settings of the group of part.
  Append "ink" to list3.
  Append number2 to list4.
  Subtract number2 from v.
If v is more than 0, then
  Append "dummy" to list3.
  Append v to list4.
Return a weighted pick from list3 on util using given (arg1, arg2) { Return list4 at arg2. }.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
If the first x in arg where the value "no" of x is 1, then
  For each part in the parts of the enemy, finish off part.
  Return true.
If the current state is 15, then
  If every x in list where part x of the enemy is judged dead, then change state to 13.
  Otherwise, change state to 12.
  Return true.
If the current state is 14, then return false.
Let list3 be [].
If the first x in arg where the value "no" of x is 2, then append 2 to list3.
If the first x in arg where the value "no" of x is 3, then append 3 to list3.
Set (the register of this state)'s 'deadDeformTemcles' to list3.
Change state to 14.
Return false.
